content: A contract is an agreement between parties that creates legal obligations. I understand that contracts are the foundation of many relationships and transactions.
An offer is a proposal to enter into a contract. I understand that an offer must be definite, certain, and communicated to the offeree.
Acceptance is the agreement to an offer. I understand that acceptance must be unconditional, communicated, and mirror the terms of the offer.
Consideration is something of value exchanged between parties. I understand that consideration is necessary for a contract to be enforceable.
Intention to create legal relations is a requirement for a contract. I understand that parties must intend for their agreement to be legally binding.
Capacity is the legal ability to enter into a contract. I understand that parties must have the mental and legal capacity to contract.
Legality requires that the subject matter of a contract be lawful. I understand that contracts for illegal purposes are void.
A written contract is one that is documented in writing. I understand that some contracts must be in writing to be enforceable (Statute of Frauds).
An oral contract is one that is spoken rather than written. I understand that oral contracts can be enforceable but are harder to prove.
An implied contract is one inferred from conduct. I understand that implied contracts arise from the parties' behavior rather than explicit words.
An express contract is one where terms are explicitly stated. I understand that express contracts are clear and enforceable.
Terms are the specific provisions of a contract. I understand that terms define the rights and obligations of each party.
Conditions are events that must occur before an obligation arises. I understand that conditions precedent, concurrent, and subsequent are types of conditions.
Warranties are promises that certain facts are true. I understand that warranties create obligations and can be express or implied.
Breach is the failure to perform contractual obligations. I understand that breach gives rise to remedies for the non-breaching party.
A material breach is a serious violation that undermines the contract. I understand that material breach may justify termination.
A minor breach is a less serious violation. I understand that minor breach does not justify termination but may support damages.
Anticipatory breach occurs when a party indicates they will not perform. I understand that anticipatory breach allows the other party to act immediately.
Remedies are the legal solutions for breach. I understand that remedies include damages, specific performance, and rescission.
Damages are monetary compensation for breach. I understand that damages may be compensatory, consequential, liquidated, or punitive.
Specific performance is a court order to perform contractual obligations. I understand that specific performance is used when damages are inadequate.
Rescission is the cancellation of a contract. I understand that rescission returns parties to their pre-contract positions.
A void contract is one that is not legally enforceable from the start. I understand that void contracts have no legal effect.
A voidable contract is one that may be canceled at the option of a party. I understand that voidable contracts are valid until rescinded.
An unenforceable contract is one that cannot be enforced in court. I understand that unenforceable contracts may be valid but lack a remedy.
Duress is coercion that makes a contract voidable. I understand that contracts entered under duress are not valid.
Undue influence is a relationship that allows one party to dominate another. I understand that contracts under undue influence are voidable.
Misrepresentation is a false statement that induces a contract. I understand that misrepresentation can make a contract voidable.
Fraud is a deliberate misrepresentation. I understand that fraud makes a contract voidable and may support damages.
A mistake is an error that affects the validity of a contract. I understand that mutual, unilateral, or common mistakes can make contracts void or voidable.
Assignment is the transfer of contractual rights to a third party. I understand that assignments are generally permissible unless prohibited by the contract.
Delegation is the transfer of contractual duties to a third party. I understand that delegation is generally permissible unless the duties are personal.
A third-party beneficiary is someone who benefits from a contract but is not a party. I understand that third-party beneficiaries may enforce contract rights.
Novation is the replacement of a contract with a new one. I understand that novation extinguishes the original contract and creates a new one.
Termination is the ending of a contract. I understand that termination can occur by performance, agreement, breach, or law.
Expiration is the natural end of a contract. I understand that contracts may expire after a specified period.
Force majeure is an unforeseeable event that prevents performance. I understand that force majeure clauses excuse performance in certain circumstances.
Impossibility is the inability to perform due to circumstances. I understand that impossibility may discharge contractual obligations.
Frustration is the failure of the purpose of a contract. I understand that frustration may discharge obligations.
Good faith is the duty to act honestly and fairly. I understand that good faith is implied in many contracts.
Fair dealing is the duty to act in a manner that does not unfairly disadvantage the other party. I understand that fair dealing is implied in many contracts.
Contract interpretation is the process of determining the meaning of contractual terms. I understand that interpretation considers text, context, and intent.
Ambiguity is uncertainty in contractual terms. I understand that ambiguous terms are construed against the drafter (contra proferentem).
Severability allows the remainder of a contract to survive if one provision is invalid. I understand that severability clauses protect contracts from partial invalidity.
An entire agreement clause states that a contract is the complete agreement. I understand that entire agreement clauses prevent claims based on prior statements.
Confidentiality clauses protect proprietary information. I understand that confidentiality is essential in many agreements.
Non-compete clauses restrict competition. I understand that non-compete clauses are subject to reasonableness and enforceability constraints.
Indemnity clauses require one party to compensate another for losses. I understand that indemnity clauses allocate risk.
Arbitration is a method of resolving disputes outside court. I understand that arbitration clauses require parties to submit disputes to an arbitrator.

A sovereign contract is one entered into by a sovereign entity on its own terms. I understand that a sovereign entity cannot be forced into a contract against its will — consent is the foundation of any binding agreement.
